# Elmish.Avalonia.Glue

Avalonia-first Elmish adapters: immutable F# state, ordinary AXAML bindings and stable CLR hosts. Projection uses explicit viewmodels; ElmView uses immutable F# view records with handwritten generated-shaped hosts. Core supplies framework-neutral notifications and keyed collections.

## Task router

- Install and start: https://adz.github.io/Elmish.Avalonia.Glue/guides/install.html and /guides/connect-runtime.html
- Choose Projection, snapshot host, ElmView or collections: https://adz.github.io/Elmish.Avalonia.Glue/index.html#choose-the-adapter
- TwoWay edits and nested nodes: /guides/route-editable-elmview-properties.html and /guides/nested-elmview-paths.html
- Lists, preview, background work: /guides/keyed-collections.html, /guides/design-time-preview.html, /guides/background-commands.html
- Headless testing and all-F# UI: /guides/testing-headlessly.html and /guides/all-fsharp-ui.html
- Symptoms and vocabulary: /guides/troubleshooting.html and /guides/glossary.html
- Generated entity API: https://adz.github.io/Elmish.Avalonia.Glue/api.html
- Package maturity ratings: https://adz.github.io/Elmish.Avalonia.Glue/guides/package-maturity.html
